text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ho, looks like training is going smoothly.
I brought some refreshments today.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's drinkable hot spring water from Yukoma!
Replenish your minerals and fluids properly,
and make sure to take regular breaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proprietress praised our training session!
She seems to think reasonably well of us.
